records.issue_text: packages/core/EventManager.ts:375 — Passing the entire destination array to each credential causes Office365, Lark, and BaseCalendarService to select the organizer’s calendar for secondary hosts, resulting in failed or misdirected event creation.
records.rationale: The finding is correct. Looking at the Office365CalendarService.ts diff (lines 70-76), the code uses `const [mainHostDestinationCalendar] = event.destinationCalendar ?? [];` which always selects the first destination calendar from the array. Unlike GoogleCalendarService which was updated to use `calEventRaw.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.credentialId === credentialId)` to match the destination calendar to the current credential, Office365 just takes the first one. This means when multiple hosts have different destination calendars, additional hosts using Office365 would write to the or
